title: Ore to Yu Nii! TV Anime Debuts in January 2027, Reveals Teaser Promo Video
content:
DMM Pictures revealed a teaser promotional video and the January 2027 debut on Friday for Ore to Yu Nii! (Me and Older Brother Yu), the television anime based on Miyuki Nakayama 's Shota x Oni (or Shota Oni ) boys-love manga . The video reveals the anime will debut in January 2027, and also reveals more staff.

Studio Hibari is animating the series. Yumi Kuroiwa (sub-character design for HYPNOSISMIC -Division Rap Battle- Rhyme Anima PLUS (TV 2) ) is designing the characters, and Yukari Hashimoto ( I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day , Mr. Osomatsu ) and Ruka Kawada ( Is the order a rabbit? , The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife ) are composing the music at Pony Canyon .

Other newly announced staff members include:

• Art Director: Hirofune Hane

• Color Design: Saki Tada

• Director of Photography: Sena Nakagawa

• Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera

Noriko Hashimoto ( Given movies 2024 ) is directing the anime and Yuniko Ayana ( Given TV , BanG Dream! ) is overseeing the series scripts.

The story is about an elementary school boy named Tsubaki and his childhood friend Yū, who is in high school. Tsubaki loves Yū, but Yū always treats Tsubaki like a child. Tsubaki thinks, "I'll grow up quickly so I can make Yū happy!"

Nakayama ( Blend S , Spirits & Cat Ears ) debuted the manga on the Comic CMOA website as part of the launch for Square Enix 's boys-love manga label "Gangan BLiss" in September 2021. The series is also on Manga UP! , ebookjapan, LINE Manga, and Kindle Store. Square Enix published the manga's seventh volume on March 21.

The manga won the Best Next Generation (Newcomer) award at boys-love website Chil-Chil's 13th annual BL Awards in 2022.
author: ANN

title: Original Anime Maiden Blood by Studio Polygon Pictures Announced for 2027
content:
A new original anime titled Maiden Blood has been announced for a 2027 premiere, with a teaser trailer and key visual released alongside the first staff and voice cast.

The dark fantasy action series is created by Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, and Pony Canyon, with Polygon Pictures handling animation production. Kishi serves as director, while Uezu is responsible for series composition and illustrator LAM drew the original character designs. The full staff credits include:

• Original Work: Seiji Kishi×Makoto Uezu×PONY CANYON

• Director: Seiji Kishi

• Series Composition: Makoto Uezu

• Original Character Design: LAM

• Sound Director: Satoki Iida

• Music: Keiichi Okabe, Kuniyuki Takahashi, Taichi Jouraku

• Music Production: PONY CANYON

• Music Production Cooperation: MONACA

• Animation Production: Polygon Pictures

Official introduction:

A rmageddon—the final war between good and evil, fought at the end of the world. Its destined outcome was overturned. “I don’t want to die.” That desperate wish, that hopeless human ego, gave power to the Evil God. Eight billion human beings were offered as sacrifices, and only a handful were allowed to survive, doomed to be toyed with and tormented as playthings of the Evil God. Since the dawn of the universe, the Frashokereti—the Renewal of the World—has been repeated countless times. But here, for the first time, it has failed. The sun will rise no more. In a world where the very laws of nature have gone mad, there is only one thing of value: human blood. Blood is currency. Blood is fuel. Blood is—a weapon. After countless sacrifices, the mages devised a single ritual: a forbidden art that transforms a girl’s blood into a blade capable of destroying demons. Turn blood into a weapon. Turn life into a weapon. Turn humanity itself into the final weapon against the demons. The chosen… the survivors… the strongest, cursed blood warriors. Blood warriors. The younger sister, Epica, is the strongest blood warrior, her soul stolen away. The elder sister, Eva, has been unable to walk since birth. And yet, in this entire world, only one thing can awaken Epica’s sleeping power: Eva’s blood. Eva and Epica. Sisters bound by fate in the darkness of the end of the world. To the demons who have defiled this world—with that blood… f×cking kill them all!”

The main voice cast includes:

• Iori Saeki as Eva

• Yukari Anzai as Epica

You can see the two characters on the key visual below.

Kishi previously directed titles including Assassination Classroom , Classroom of the Elite , and Blue Orchestra , while Uezu’s credits include Yuki Yuna Is a Hero , KONOSUBA , and Kengan Ashura .
author: Anime Corner

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Anime Film's Battle Scene Clip Streamed
content:
The staff for Sekiro: No Defeat , the new anime based on FromSoftware 's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice game, began streaming a battle scene clip from the film on Friday.

Crunchyroll will exclusively stream the anime in 2026 worldwide excluding Japan, China, Korea, Russia, and Belarus. The anime screened out of competition at this year's Annecy International Animation Film Festival.

The Japanese cast members from the game are reprising their roles, including:

• Daisuke Namikawa as Sekiro

• Miyuki Satō as Kuro

• Kenjirō Tsuda as Genichiro Ashina

• Jin Urayama as Sculptor

• Shizuka Itō as Emma

• Akimitsu Takase as Hanbei

• Takaya Hashi as Owl

• Tetsuo Kanao as Isshin Ashina

Kenichi Kutsuna is directing the anime at Qzil.la . Takuya Satou is the screenwriter. Takahiro Kishida ( Durarara!! ) is designing the characters. Shūta Hasunuma is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Shunsuke Fukui

• Chief Animation Director: Kaito Mogi

• Action Animation Director: Takashi Mukouda

• Art Director: Yūji Kaneko

• Color Key Artist: Azusa Sasaki

• Compositing Director of Photography: Keisuke Nozawa

• Editor: Yoshinori Murakami

• Sound Director: Yasushi Nagura

• Producer: ARCH

• Liquid Art: Atsushi Harada

• Color Grading: Tatsuya Fukumoto

• Sound Effects: Kiyotaka Kawata

• Pre-Production, Post Production: Studio Betta

The anime's theme song is "Blu" from composer Ryuichi Sakamoto 's The Best of 'Playing the Orchestra 2014' album.

The staff issued an official statement in August 2025 confirming that no AI was being used for this anime.

Publisher Activision describes Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice :

Directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki , and published by Activision , Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is a third-person, action-adventure game with RPG elements. The single-player game puts players in the protagonist role of a hard-hearted warrior whose mission is to rescue his master, a young lord who is the descendant of an ancient bloodline, and exact revenge on his arch nemesis. Set in the re-imagined world of late 1500s Sengoku Japan; a brutal, bloody period of constant life-and-death conflict, in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice you are the “one-armed wolf,” a disgraced and disfigured warrior rescued from the brink of death. In the game, players come face-to-face with larger than life foes; unleash an arsenal of deadly prosthetic tools and powerful ninja abilities to blend stealth, vertical traversal, and visceral head-to-head combat in a bloody confrontation. Take revenge. Restore your honor. Kill Ingeniously.

The game launched for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in March 2019, and it sold more than 2 million copies worldwide in less than 10 days.

title: 'A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage' TV Anime Reveals Cast, Staff, January 2027 Debut in Video
content:
King Amusement Creative revealed a teaser promotional video on Friday for the television anime of storywriter Shinichi Sawaragi and artist Tanku Gasuyama 's A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage ( Pen to Wappa to Jijitsu Kon ) manga. The company also revealed the main cast and staff, a teaser visual, and the show's January 2027 debut.

The anime will star Tomoaki Maeno as Eiji Kirisame and Inori Minase as Tsugumi Kuchinashi.

Takaaki Ishiyama ( Chaos;HEAd , Fairy Musketeers ) is directing the anime at EMT Squared . Shigeru Murakoshi ( Snowball Earth , Zombie Land Saga ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Miyuki Nakamura ( The Unaware Atelier Master ) is designing the characters. Hiroto Morishita ( The Faraway Paladin , Wistoria: Wand and Sword ) is the sound director and Kana Hashiguchi ( Classroom of the Elite (TV 3) , Black Fox ) is composing the music.

Yen Press announced in August 2025 it had licensed the manga, and it released the first volume in English on March 24. The publisher describes the story:

Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say... “Will you marry me?!”

Sawaragi and Gasuyama launched the manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in December 2022. Hakusensha published the seventh volume on April 28. The manga has 400,000 copies in circulation.

title: Ichigo Struggles Against Yhwach in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 45 Preview
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 5 (Episode 45 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes. In the previous episode, Zaraki and Toshiro revealed their Bankai abilities, with Yuki Kaji joining the voice cast as the older version of Toshiro.

The fifth episode is titled “XXXX,” and it will premiere on Saturday, August 22. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

The threat of the annihilation of the Three Worlds becomes a reality, as the shadow of destruction spreads across the realms. At Wahr Welt, Ichigo confronts Yhwach and awakens the Hollow power within him, entering a state of partial Hollowfication. He unleashes a Gran Rey Cero fused with the power of Getsuga. Yet even this devastating attack fails to faze Yhwach. As he overwhelms Ichigo, Yhwach confronts him with the weakness of his “power to protect.”

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 45 Staff:

• Script: Tomohisa Taguchi

• Storyboard: Tomohisa Taguchi

• Episode Director: Tomohisa Taguchi

• Chief Animation Director: Kiyoshi Komatsubara

• Animation Directors: Yosuke Kabashima (Studio KAI), Kazuhito Tominaga (Studio KAI), Asuka Nakachi (Studio KAI), Takahito Katayama, Yukio Hasegawa, Heigo Akashi

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: 'Matsurika Kanriden' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rinne Ishida 's Matsurika Kanriden ( The Legend of Bureaucrat Matsurika ) light novel revealed additional cast, staff, the opening theme, and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX, MBS, TV Aichi, and BS11 in January 2027.

Cast Tenga Rei: Takeo Ootsuka ( [Oshi no Ko] ) Shisei Hou: Koutarou Nishiyama ( Tougen Anki ) Shunsetsu Shou: Shou Komura ( Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!? )

Staff Chief Animation Director: Manami Inose ( Gekai Elise ), Kaho Deguchi ( Kami-tachi ni Hirowareta Otoko ) Art Director: Satoshi Shibata ( Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni. ) Color Design: Kumiko Akahori ( Sekai Saikyou no Kouei: Meikyuukoku no Shinjin Tansakusha ) Director of Photography: Yukina Nomura ( 100-man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru ) Editing: Honami Yamagishi ( SK∞ ) Sound Director: Yasunori Ebina ( Jigokuraku )

Rock band KANA-BOON ( Naruto: Shippuuden ) is performing the opening theme "Hanabanashi," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Yuuichi Nakazawa ( Toaru Ossan no VRMMO Katsudouki ) is directing the anime at Maho Film , with Touko Machida ( Isekai Nonbiri Nouka ) handling the series composition. Manami Inose ( Ao no Miburo: Serizawa Ansatsu-hen ) is designing the characters. Takurou Iga ( Kakuriyo no Yadomeshi Ni ) is composing the music.

Ishida began penning the historical fantasy light novel under the B's-LOG Bunko imprint in July 2017, featuring illustrations by Izumi ( Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru ). Kadokawa published the 18th volume in October 2025.

Monthly Princess began serializing a manga adaptation by Waka Takase in August 2018. Akita Shoten released the 12th volume in October 2025.

Mito Aoi began serializing the Juusansai no Tanjoubi, Kougou ni Narimashita. ( On My 13th Birthday, I Became an Empress ) spin-off manga in Monthly Princess in March 2020. The nintu volume went on sale on March 16.

title: Saijakuna Boku wa 'Kabenuke Bug' de Nariagaru TV Anime Debuts in 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yui Hata 's manga adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa 's Saijakuna Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe o Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Hōshū o Mugen Kaishū Dekimashita! (I, The Weakest Player, Will Rise to the Top Using a "Wall-Clipping Glitch" – By Clipping Through Walls, I Earned the First-Time Clear Reward Infinite Times!) novel series revealed on Friday the anime will debut in 2027. The website also revealed the main cast and staff, and a teaser visual.

The anime will star Riko Aono as Anri and Momoka Terasawa as Elelet (character name romanizations are not confirmed).

Haruki Kasugamori ( Dragon Goes House-Hunting , Tono to Inu ) is directing the anime at Durandal and Tengu Kobou . Hiroshi Hosokawa ( Otherworldly Munchkin ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Saint Seiya: Legend of Sanctuary , Eiga Precure Dream Stars! ) and Sumakidori ( Miru: Paths To My Future ) are designing the characters.

The series follows Anri, who is a weak young adventurer trying to earn money for his younger sister. Anri's weak "Evasion" skill gets him kicked out of his party. However, he discovers a glitch that allows him to use "Evasion" to clip through walls and earn the first-time clear reward infinite times. By doing this, he rises from the bottom by boosting his stats and collecting rare items.

Kitagawa debuted the web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in February 2021. The light novels launched in June 2022 with illustrations by Meto Sasame . The second volume shipped in May 2024.

Hata began a manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Shōnen Magazine R in July 2022 until the magazine ended publication in January 2023. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app that same month. Kodansha published the manga's 12th volume on July 9.

Haruki Kasugamori ( Dragon Goes House-Hunting , Tono to Inu ) is directing the anime at Durandal and Tengu Kobou . Hiroshi Hosokawa ( Otherworldly Munchkin ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Saint Seiya: Legend of Sanctuary , Eiga Precure Dream Stars! ) and Sumakidori ( Miru: Paths To My Future ) are designing the characters.

The series follows Anri, who is a weak young adventurer trying to earn money for his younger sister. Anri's weak "Evasion" skill gets him kicked out of his party. However, he discovers a glitch that allows him to use "Evasion" to clip through walls and earn the first-time clear reward infinite times. By doing this, he rises from the bottom by boosting his stats and collecting rare items.
Kitagawa debuted the web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in February 2021. The light novels launched in June 2022 with illustrations by Meto Sasame . The second volume shipped in May 2024.

Hata began a manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Shōnen Magazine R in July 2022 until the magazine ended publication in January 2023. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app that same month. Kodansha published the manga's 12th volume on July 9.

title: Matsurika Kanriden Releases New Trailer Featuring Opening Theme Song by Kana Boon
content:
The previously announced Matsurika Kanriden anime released a new trailer featuring the opening thems song “Hana Hanashi” by Kana Boon. The anime is slated to broadcast in January 2027 with Maho Film in charge of the animation.

Rie Takahashi stars as Matsurika Ko and Nobunaga Shimazaki as Emperor Hakuyo. Three new voice cast members were also revealed:

• Takeo Otsuka as Tenga Rei

• Kotaro Nishiyama as Shisei Ho

• Sho Komura as Shunsetsu Sho

Takeshi Mori is the chief director while Yuichi Nakazawa is the director. Toko Machida is handling the series composition, Manami Inose is on character designs, and Takuro Iga is composing the music. The story follows the titular character, Matsurika, a lady-in-waiting at the imperial palace known for her excellent memory. One day, she meets the emperor, who falls in love with her, but tells her to approach him only after passing an exam.

The light novel series is written by Rinne Ishida and has been published under Kadokawa’s B’s-LOG Bunko label since July 2017. There is also a manga adaptation by Waka Takase, which has been serialized in Akita Shoten’s shojo manga magazine Princess since August 2018.

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Reveals Cour 2 Visual, Heroines Cover Mrs. GREEN APPLE's "Ao to Natsu"
content:
Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime revealed a new key visual for its second cour, ahead of the anime’s October 2026 return. The first cour concluded in March. Studio feel. is in charge of the animation. The main voice cast for the anime includes:

• Shogo Sakata as Saku Chitose

• Manaka Iwami as Yuko Hiiragi

• Hina Youmiya as Yua Uchida

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Yuzuki Nanase

• Rumi Okubo as Haru Aomi

• Chika Anzai as Asuka Nishino

You can see the main characters in the new visual below.

A new music project featuring the five heroines covering songs associated with youth was also announced. The first release is a cover of Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s “Ao to Natsu,” with a music video now available.

The following staff is credited for the Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime:

• Original Work: Hiromu

• Original Character Design: raemz

• Director: Yuji Tokuno

• Series Structure: Naruhisa Arakawa

• Script: Hiromu, Naruhisa Arakawa

• Character Design: Sumie Kinoshita

• Animation Production: feel.

The anime is adapting a light novel series written by Hiromu and illustrated by raemz. Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle has been serialized by Shogakukan’s Gagaga Bunko imprint since June 2019. A manga adaptation by Bobcat began in Square Enix’s Manga Up! in April 2020.

Yen Press licensed the light novel l in English, describing the story: Being popular isn’t easy. It’s hard to beat Saku Chitose. The most popular kid in his high school? Check. An ironclad reputation that can weather even vicious online attacks? Check. A group of friends as attractive on the outside as they are inside? Check. But when a teacher asks for his help bringing back a student who has been shut away in his room for months, Saku’s perfect world will never be the same. What is this, some kind of normie harem story…?
author: Anime Corner
